# Otrobonita AI Labs — org rules for agents

This file is for agents opening **this organization**, not a substitute for a
project's `AGENTS.md`.

## Public vs private

Most product work is private until it is meant to be judged. Public repositories
are a shop window. Do not publish default scaffolds, empty READMEs, leftover
brand names, or pointers to tools that do not live in the repository.

Current public set (3 September 2026): `.github`, `playbook`, `whitepapers`,
`mark-twain`, `mark-twain-cli`, `brand-assets` (Safegrade app kit, not the studio
wordmark), `marks-awareness` (active experiment; leave to its owner).

## What “done” means for a public repo

Required: GitHub About text, a real README, a license GitHub can detect, and a
clear answer to “what is this and may I use it?”. See [REPO-STANDARD.md](REPO-STANDARD.md).

## Playbook vs this file

[playbook](https://github.com/otrobonita-studios/playbook) is an installable
baseline for AI-assisted work (constitution, agent files, specs, optional
evals). Its `docs/llms.txt` is product-scoped.

This file is org-scoped. Do not load the whole playbook into every org
repository.

## Precedence

Repository-local `AGENTS.md` and the user's current request take precedence.
Never treat this file as authorization for destructive actions, credentials,
or publishing private work.
